title: Block method validation based on impossible dates
prompt:
Reject impossible calendar dates in lib/ohworks-method-validation.ts. The local isUtcTimestamp predicate at lines 157-158 accepts any Z-suffixed value normalized by Date.parse; lines 258-269 trust it for runAt and validatedAt. Verified reproduction: a validated method with validatedAt 2026-02-30T00:00:00Z, interval 30 days, matrix water, and runAt 2026-03-03T00:00:00Z returns reported with method-validated-and-current. February 30 is silently converted into March 2. The method-performance view consumes this decision at lib/ohworks-demo-method-performance-view.ts:210-212, rendered on app/pilot/ohworks/qc/page.tsx:200.

Strengthen only this module's timestamp predicate to validate literal UTC ISO calendar and clock fields, including month lengths and leap years, before accepting the instant. Keep valid Z timestamps with and without fractional seconds. Impossible run and validation dates must produce the existing blocked outcomes run-timestamp-invalid and validation-timestamp-invalid respectively. Preserve interval thresholds, validation states, matrix matching, and precedence for otherwise valid input; do not change shared date utilities or views.

Add tests/ohworks/method-validation-calendar-dates.test.ts with February 30, April 31, a non-leap February 29, valid leap-day controls, and invalid clock fields in each timestamp position. Assert decisions and exact reason codes. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/method-validation-calendar-dates.test.ts tests/ohworks/method-validation.test.ts tests/ohworks/demo-method-performance-view.test.ts. Use synthetic fixtures; work on the assigned branch you are on. Edit only the named production file and new test. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflows, package.json, auth changes, commits, or pushes.
